entry.title: New: dsh-simple-wiki-memory
entry.summary: A super-simplified LLM-wiki memory plugin: one index document (auto-loaded) + one markdown file per topic (read only when needed) — no dumping everything into the context and burning tokens. Simple and lightweight, painless to install/uninstall, and freely editable however you like. Exact install spec: github:rainow/dsh-simple-wiki-memory. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
